description: This file defines CLI commands for managing hooks in the openclaw project, including listing, info, check, enable, disable, install, and update hooks, with functions for formatting output and handling hook state changes.

methods.name: mergeHookEntries
methods.description: Merges plugin and workspace hook entries into a single list.

methods.name: buildHooksReport
methods.description: Builds a comprehensive report of hook statuses based on current configuration.

methods.name: resolveHookForToggle
methods.description: Resolves a hook by name for toggling, ensuring it exists and is eligible.

methods.name: buildConfigWithHookEnabled
methods.description: Returns a new configuration with a specified hook enabled or disabled.

methods.name: formatHookStatus
methods.description: Formats the status of a hook for display.

methods.name: formatHookName
methods.description: Formats the display name of a hook.

methods.name: formatHookSource
methods.description: Formats the source information of a hook.

methods.name: formatHookMissingSummary
methods.description: Creates a summary string of missing requirements for a hook.

methods.name: exitHooksCliWithError
methods.description: Logs an error message and exits the process.

methods.name: writeHooksOutput
methods.description: Outputs hook data in JSON or plain text format.

methods.name: runHooksCliAction
methods.description: Executes an async action with error handling for CLI commands.

methods.name: formatHooksList
methods.description: Generates a formatted string listing all hooks with status and details.

methods.name: formatHookInfo
methods.description: Generates detailed info about a specific hook.

methods.name: formatHooksCheck
methods.description: Generates a report on hooks' eligibility status.

methods.name: enableHook
methods.description: Enables a specified hook by updating the configuration.

methods.name: disableHook
methods.description: Disables a specified hook by updating the configuration.

methods.name: registerHooksCli
methods.description: Registers CLI commands for managing hooks.
